name: Audiology and Speech Therapy
overview: Audiology and Speech Therapy is a dynamic and specialized field that focuses on assessing, diagnosing, and treating individuals with communication and hearing disorders. This profession combines anatomy, physiology, linguistics, and psychology knowledge to help patients of all ages improve their communication and hearing abilities through evidence-based interventions and advanced technology.

topJobs.role: General Audiology or Speech Pathology Assistant
topJobs.description: Provide support during evaluations, therapy sessions, and administrative tasks.
Assess and treat speech, language, and swallowing disorders through personalized plans.
Assess hearing loss and manage hearing/balance disorders with personalized treatment.
Support research studies through data collection, analysis, and literature reviews.

Pursue undergraduate degree (BASLP or related program)
Complete clinical internships and practical training
Take standardized tests (GRE or program entrance exams)
